output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls mintToken, the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount; Transfer(0, this, mintedAmount); Transfer(this, target, mintedAmount); is executed, if mintedAmount is large enough, the totalSupply value can overflow, causing it to become unusable, and allowing the owner to steal the funds of any user.

The transfer function has an unchecked external call vulnerability. The transfer function has a call to msg.sender.send which is not safe for calling contracts. This can be exploited by a contract that delegates nearly all gas (using call.gas) to the transfer function, then reverts, which reverts the transaction, reverts the state, and reverts all balanceOf[_to] += _value; balanceOf[_from] -= _value; transactions that called the contract. This can be used to block the contract from working, and to block other users from using the contract.
